issues.text: Round 2 made section 5 say DonHangDbContext asks for its options and the container passes them in. The Try-it instruction says to continue until a class needs nothing else "you know about", so a reader following the lesson adds DonHangDbContext -> its options, but the expected result stops at DonHangDbContext. Not wrong, but the learner's correct answer does not match the key.

The instruction says to stop at 'a class the container can build without asking for anything else', but the expected result ends at 'its options' (not a class name) and at `ILogger<LoggingNotifier>` (an interface; the lesson never says which class answers it). I would know I succeeded, but I briefly wondered whether I should go past the logger.
issues.quote: keep going until every branch ends at a class the container can build without asking for anything else you know about.
issues.fix: Replace 'ends at a class the container can build' with 'ends at something the lesson does not take further'.
